browser_search.result: The visible search dialog remained in its initial prompt with no results after input. This is an unsuccessful search execution, not zero matching documents.

qualified_negative: No separate authored public product or bot page was identified in the inspected English/Chinese navigation or these bounded official-domain searches. Existing owned docs and licensed-client audit remain the stronger available evidence. No exhaustive web-absence claim.
batch_limit: The web tool returns combined batch results; no per-query absence or complete search-index coverage is inferred.
